channel.title: Japan Life Info - Visa
channel.description: Japan visa and residence status information

item.title: Key Factors Japan Looks at When Screening Your Visa
item.description: A breakdown of the key factors that Japan's Immigration Services Agency (ISA) evaluates during visa screening — including education, work history, income, taxes, pension, and residence history — plus special points for Spouse Visa and Permanent Residence applications.

item.title: What Is Japan's Immigration Services Agency?
item.description: Learn what the Immigration Services Agency of Japan (出入国在留管理庁) does — from visa screening and residence status management to permanent residency and residence cards. A clear overview of the core agency that handles all immigration administration for foreigners in Japan.

item.title: What to Watch Out for at Japanese Immigration Inspection
item.description: A practical guide to navigating immigration inspection in Japan. From explaining your entry purpose and having accommodation details ready, to carrying your Certificate of Eligibility (COE) and understanding your residence card obligations — key points every long-term resident should know before arriving.

item.title: Who Gets a Longer Period of Stay in Japan? Key Traits That Matter
item.description: What do people who receive 3-year or 5-year periods of stay in Japan have in common? This guide covers the key factors the Immigration Services Agency evaluates — including stable employment, tax and pension payments, and past visa history.

item.title: Japan Residence Period: 1-Year, 3-Year, and 5-Year Differences
item.description: What determines whether you receive a 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year period of stay in Japan? This guide covers the criteria behind each duration, reasons why you might keep getting 1-year renewals, and what you can do to increase your period of stay.

item.title: Understanding Status of Residence: Essential Knowledge for Long-Term Stay in Japan
item.description: If you are planning to work, study, marry, or live long-term in Japan, this guide covers everything you need to know — including the concept of Status of Residence (在留資格), how it differs from a visa, and a clear breakdown of the 7 most common statuses.

item.title: Japan Set to Dramatically Raise Visa Fees — Permanent Residency Application Cost May Surge Up to 2,900%
item.description: The Japanese government is pushing to raise visa renewal and permanent residency application fees by up to 30 times. Here's what workers and students need to know about the changes and how to prepare.

item.title: Japan Tightens Business Manager Visa Requirements — Capital Threshold Rises 6x to ¥30 Million
item.description: Japan has raised the capital requirement for its Business Manager visa from ¥5M to ¥30M — a 6x jump. Here's what foreign entrepreneurs need to know to prepare.

item.title: Complete Guide to ID Photo Specifications for Japanese Visa Applications
item.description: ID photo specifications are one of the most common mistakes in visa applications. Check the correct size, shooting conditions, and reasons for rejection all in one place.

item.title: Residence Card Address Change in Japan: Deadline and Penalties
item.description: Learn how to report your address change on your residence card after moving in Japan. 14-day deadline, required documents, penalties, and practical risks.

item.title: Complete Guide to Residence Card Address Change Procedure in Japan
item.description: Step-by-step guide to changing your address on your residence card in Japan. Same city vs different city procedures, required documents, processing time, and important notes.

item.title: Penalties for Not Carrying Your Residence Card in Japan
item.description: Learn about the obligation to always carry your residence card in Japan, penalties for violations, when you may be asked to show it, and exceptions.

item.title: What to Do When You Lose Your Residence Card in Japan
item.description: Step-by-step guide on what to do if you lose your residence card in Japan. Police report, reissuance within 14 days, required documents, and overseas loss procedures.

item.title: Can I Apply for a Japanese Spouse Visa Right After Marriage Registration?
item.description: Learn about the timing, review points, and precautions for applying for a Japanese spouse visa after international marriage.

item.title: Top Reasons Why Japan Spouse Visas Get Rejected
item.description: Learn the main reasons spouse visa applications are denied in Japan. Understand fake marriage suspicion, financial requirements, and stay history issues.

item.title: Fastest Route from Spouse Visa to Permanent Residency in Japan
item.description: Learn the fastest path from a spouse visa to permanent residency in Japan. Understand the 1-year application possibility, key requirements, and realistic timelines.

item.title: Emergency Actions Before Your Visa Expires (Japan Status of Residence Guide)
item.description: A guide on what to do when your visa expiration date is approaching. Learn about the grace period, overstay consequences, and prevention tips.

item.title: Complete Guide to Japanese Status of Residence Application Fees and Costs for New Applications, Renewals, and Changes
item.description: A comprehensive summary of official fees and administrative scrivener costs for new applications, renewals, and changes of status of residence in Japan.

item.title: Benefits of Obtaining Permanent Residence from a Work Visa in Japan
item.description: A summary of the concrete advantages of switching from a work visa to permanent residence, including stability, career freedom, and financial credibility.

item.title: Complete Guide to the COE (Certificate of Eligibility) Issuance Process
item.description: A step-by-step guide to obtaining the COE (Certificate of Eligibility) required before working in Japan.

item.title: Common Reasons for Work Visa Rejection in Japan
item.description: Key reasons why Japanese work visas get rejected and how to avoid rejection.

item.title: What happens if you get caught working illegally in Japan?
item.description: If caught working illegally in Japan, you face deportation, re-entry bans, and severe disadvantages in future visa screenings.

item.title: Real Cases of Illegal Employment Detection in Japan
item.description: A compilation of real illegal employment cases detected in Japan. Learn about technical trainee runaways, working outside visa scope, employer penalties, and more.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Get a Japanese Status of Residence?
item.description: A summary of processing times for new applications, renewals, and changes, plus reasons for delays and how to prepare strategically.

item.title: Can You Change from a Short-Term Visa to a Long-Term Visa in Japan?
item.description: Can you switch from a tourist visa to a work visa while in Japan? Learn the rules, exceptions, and the correct procedure.

item.title: Can You Work in Japan on a Tourist Visa?
item.description: Working on a tourist visa in Japan is strictly illegal. Learn the consequences and legal alternatives.

item.title: Do You Need a Visa to Travel to Japan?
item.description: Whether you need a visa to visit Japan depends on your nationality. Here is a complete guide by country.

item.title: When Should You Start Preparing for Your Japan Visa Renewal?
item.description: A guide on the timing and key considerations for renewing your Japan visa (Application for Extension of Period of Stay). Overstaying even by one day is illegal.

item.description: A step-by-step guide for first-time applicants. We cover the most important points and practical procedures for Japanese status of residence applications.

item.description: The jurisdiction of the Immigration Services Agency differs depending on your place of residence when applying for a visa. Check the addresses and phone numbers of the main offices and branch offices for all 47 prefectures.

item.title: Top 20 Questions Beginners Ask About Japanese Visas and Status of Residence
item.description: Know this about Japanese status of residence, and half your problems are solved. We have compiled 20 of the most frequently asked questions by those preparing for their status of residence for the first time.

item.title: Japanese Language Requirements Under Discussion — Japan's New Foreign Resident Policy Changes
item.description: The Japanese government is considering adding Japanese language proficiency as a requirement for permanent residency and long-term stay. Learn about the key policy changes and how to prepare.

item.title: Artist - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for artists such as composers, painters, and sculptors earning income in Japan. Check category-specific paperwork and review criteria.

item.title: Business Manager - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for managing or operating a business in Japan. Covers capital requirements, office space, business plans, and key submission criteria.

item.title: Cultural Activities - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for unpaid academic or artistic activities in Japan such as tea ceremony, flower arrangement, and martial arts. Includes proof of activities and financial support.

item.title: Dependent - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for spouses and children of work or student visa holders to reside in Japan. Covers family relationship proof and financial support documentation.

item.title: Designated Activities (Amateur Athletes and Their Family Members) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for amateur athletes supported by Japanese organizations and their family members. Covers athletic career proof, contracts, and support documentation.

item.title: Designated Activities (Digital Nomad) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for digital nomads working remotely for overseas employers while residing in Japan, plus spouses and children. Check income, insurance, and nationality requirements.

item.title: Designated Activities (Domestic Worker for Highly Skilled Professionals) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for domestic workers employed by Highly Skilled Professional or Special Highly Skilled foreign nationals. Covers employment contracts, household income, and experience requirements.

item.title: Designated Activities (Domestic Worker) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for domestic workers employed by diplomats and consular officers. Covers employer visa proof, employment contracts, and worker experience documentation.

item.title: Designated Activities (Continued Job Seeking for Graduates of Japanese Universities) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for international students who graduated from Japanese universities to continue job-seeking activities. Covers activity reports, graduation proof, and financial support.

item.title: Family Members of EPA Nurses and EPA Care Workers - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for family members of EPA nurses and care workers to reside in Japan. Covers family relationship and financial dependency proof under the Economic Partnership Agreement.

item.title: EPA Nurses, Care Workers, and Candidates - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for EPA nurse and care worker candidates from Indonesia, Philippines, and Vietnam. Covers host institution agreements and qualification requirements.

item.title: Designated Activities (Stay Until Graduate School Enrollment) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for international graduates staying in Japan until graduate school enrollment. Covers graduation certificates, admission notices, and financial support proof.

item.title: Designated Activities (Working Spouse of Highly Skilled Professional) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for spouses of Highly Skilled Professionals to work without academic or career requirements. Covers marriage proof and HSP point calculation documents.

item.title: Designated Activities (Parents of Highly Skilled Professional or Spouse) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for parents of Highly Skilled Professionals to reside in Japan. Special conditions apply: household income over 8 million yen and childcare for children under 7.

item.title: Designated Activities (Internship, Summer Jobs, International Cultural Exchange) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for internship, summer job, and international cultural exchange program participants in Japan. Covers enrollment proof, program plans, and compensation conditions.

item.title: Designated Activities (Designated Information Processing Activities) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for designated information processing activities in the IT field. Covers IT certifications, work experience, and institutional contract documentation.

item.title: Designated Activities J-Find (Graduates of Top Overseas Universities) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for graduates of top overseas universities to seek employment or start businesses in Japan through the J-Find program. Check university ranking and savings requirements.

item.title: Designated Activities (Job Hunting for Graduates) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for graduates of Japanese universities and vocational schools to continue job-seeking activities. Covers recommendation letters and job search progress reports.

item.title: Designated Activities (Long-term Stay for Tourism/Recuperation) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for long-term stay for tourism, recuperation, or volunteer activities and spouses. Check asset requirements (30 million yen+) and insurance conditions.

item.title: Designated Activities (Stay for Job Offer Recipients) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for students with confirmed job offers to stay in Japan until employment begins. Covers job offer letters, employment start date proof, and enrollment status.

item.title: Medical Stay and Accompanying Persons - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreigners receiving medical treatment in Japan and their companions. Covers hospital diagnosis, treatment plans, and financial support proof.

item.title: Designated Activities (Designated Research Activities) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for designated research activities based on government agreements. Covers research institution contracts, research plans, and achievement documentation.

item.title: Designated Activities (Parents/Family of Designated Research Activity Holders) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for parents and family members of those engaged in designated research or information processing activities to reside in Japan.

item.title: Designated Activities (Ski Instructor) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for ski instructors working at Japanese ski resorts. Covers instructor certifications, resort contracts, and seasonal activity period (November to March).

item.title: Designated Activities (No. 46 / No. 49) Graduates of Japanese Universities - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for Japanese university graduates to work in diverse roles utilizing Japanese language skills (Designated Activities No. 46/49). JLPT N1 and graduation proof required.

item.title: Designated Activities - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for Designated Activities visa status individually specified by the Minister of Justice. Covers both publicly announced and individually permitted activity types.

item.title: Engineer/Specialist in Humanities/International Services - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for IT engineers, interpreters, designers, and marketers working in Japan. Check education and work experience requirements by category (1-4).

item.title: Entertainer - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for theater, entertainment, music, and sports performance activities in Japan. Covers performance contracts, career history, and category-specific requirements.

item.title: Highly Skilled Professional - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for point-based Highly Skilled Professional visa (academic, career, and salary criteria). Covers HSP Type 1 (a/b/c) and Type 2 point calculations and proof.

item.title: Instructor - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for language and subject teachers at elementary, middle, and high schools in Japan. Covers teaching licenses, employment institution proof, and teaching experience.

item.title: Intra-company Transferee - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for employees transferring from overseas offices to Japan. Covers transfer orders, overseas work experience (1+ year), and job description documentation.

item.title: Journalist - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreign journalists, cameramen, and editors conducting reporting activities in Japan. Covers media organization credentials and reporting activity plans.

item.title: Legal/Accounting Services - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreign lawyers, accountants, and tax advisors with professional qualifications in Japan. Covers Japanese license proof and office affiliation contracts.

item.title: Long-term Resident - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for Long-term Resident status including Japanese descendants, recognized refugees, and foreigners raising children of Japanese nationals. Covers category-specific documentation.

item.title: Medical Services - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreign doctors, dentists, pharmacists, and nurses with Japanese medical licenses. Covers license copies, workplace proof, and category-specific paperwork.

item.title: Nursing Care - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for certified care workers (kaigofukushishi) to work at nursing care facilities in Japan. Covers certification registration, facility contracts, and category requirements.

item.title: Official - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreign government officials and international organization staff performing official duties in Japan. Covers dispatch orders, official duty proof, and recommendation letters.

item.title: Professor - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for professors, lecturers, and researchers at Japanese universities and colleges. Covers employment proof, research achievements, and category-specific paperwork.

item.title: Religious Activities - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for missionary work, religious ceremonies, and religious education activities in Japan. Covers religious organization proof, dispatch letters, and activity documentation.

item.title: Researcher - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for researchers at government-affiliated institutions and corporate research labs in Japan. Covers research contracts, publication lists, and category-specific paperwork.

item.title: Skilled Labor - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for skilled workers such as foreign cuisine chefs, gemstone processors, and specialized craftsmen. Covers 10+ years experience proof and employment contracts.

item.title: Specified Skilled Worker (i) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for Specified Skilled Worker (i) across 14 industry sectors including construction, food service, and nursing care. Covers skills test, Japanese test, and support plan.

item.title: Specified Skilled Worker (ii) - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for Specified Skilled Worker (ii) — an advanced status allowing family accompaniment and unlimited renewals. Covers skills test proof and work experience by sector.

item.title: Spouse or Child of Japanese National - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreign spouses or children of Japanese nationals. Covers marriage history statement, questionnaire, relationship evidence photos, and key review documents.

item.title: Spouse or Child of Permanent Resident - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for foreign spouses or children of permanent residents. Covers marriage proof, guarantor documents, and financial capability evidence.

item.title: Student - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for studying at Japanese universities, vocational schools, and language schools. Covers admission letters, financial proof (bank statements, remittance records), and study plans.

item.title: Technical Intern Training - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for technical intern training (corporate and supervised types). Covers training plan certification, supervising organization permits, and implementing organization paperwork.

item.title: Temporary Visitor - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for extending or changing Temporary Visitor status (up to 90 days for tourism, business, or family visits). Covers extension reasons, flight tickets, and financial proof.

item.title: Trainee - Required Documents
item.description: Required documents for non-employment training activities at Japanese public and private institutions. Covers training plans, host organization details, and post-training return schedule.

item.title: Difference Between Japanese Visa and Status of Residence
item.description: Learn the exact difference between a Japanese visa (査証) and status of residence (在留資格) for long-term stay in Japan.
